story_text:
Offer Ends November 13 At 6:30 AM PT!
Comment here what you love about ClearX
Scrubbing your sneakers by hand takes time and effort. And throwing your favorite pair in the washing machine? You never know how they’ll come out.
Taking them to a professional cleaning service isn't always much better. You could wait days to get them back, pay a hefty cleaning fee, and still worry about what happens if your favorite pair gets damaged.
Your shoes deserve better care, and you deserve a break from cleaning them.
ClearX washes, dries, sanitizes, and deodorizes your shoes in one gentle, fully automated cycle, taking care of them inside and out.
Just place your shoes inside, press start, and get on with your day. In about 90 minutes, your favorite pairs can be clean, dry, fresh, and ready to wear again, right at home.
## 🧼 | One-Cycle Shoe Care
From the first wash to the final dry, ClearX takes care of every step.
Washing, drying, and sanitizing all happen in one fully automated cycle. There's no need to scrub your shoes beforehand, move them between cleaning stages, or leave them out to air-dry afterward.
Everything happens in one continuous program, without needing your help between steps, so you're free to get on with your day.
Dirt doesn't just sit on the surface. It gets trapped in shoe fibers, mesh, seams, and places your brush can't easily reach.
ClearX uses two moving spray nozzles to deliver micro-nano bubbles that help loosen dirt trapped in shoe fabrics, even on the inside.
A 3-axis robotic arm with ultra-soft velvet sleeves gently wipes the outside, while rotating shoe supports help clean from different angles.
## 💨 | Fast Drying
Washing your shoes is one thing. Waiting for them to dry can take hours.
Dual-channel warm airflow dries your shoes from the inside and outside at the same time. Built-in air channels in the shoe supports direct warm air into each shoe, while external airflow dries the outside.
The temperature stays below 50°C (122°F) to protect your shoes from excessive heat that can affect their shape, materials, and adhesives. And because they dry without direct sunlight, ClearX also helps reduce the risk of yellowing caused by sun exposure.
## 🎨 | Gentle on Materials
Soaking, harsh scrubbing, and machine tumbling can be tough on your shoes. Your favorite pairs deserve better care.
Each shoe stays securely on its own 360° rotating support. Smart measurement adjusts the cleaning movements to fit, while a pressure-sensing robotic arm uses ultra-soft velvet sleeves to wipe away dirt without harsh rubbing.
## 🦠 | Odor & Bacteria
Your shoes can look spotless and still smell like last week’s workout. Sweat and bacteria settle deep inside, where a quick wash can’t always reach.
That’s why ClearX finishes every cycle with built-in ozone sanitization and disinfection.
As your shoes dry, ozone is released intermittently to fill the chamber and gets into every corner, inside and out, helping reduce the bacteria, fungi and odors that wash and wear leave behind, without leaving a pungent smell of its own.
So your shoes don’t just look clean. They feel fresh every time you slip them on.
## ⚙️ | How It Works
## 💧 | Minimal Water
ClearX uses about 1 liter of water to wash a pair of shoes. And there's no plumbing connection required.
Simply fill the removable clean-water tank, and you're good to go. One full tank cleans 3 pairs of shoes. ClearX filters and circulates the water throughout the wash, while used water collects in a separate tank for easy disposal.
It's a smarter, water-efficient way to care for your shoes, with the freedom to place ClearX wherever it works best for you.
## 🎛️ | 4 Cleaning Modes
Some shoes need a quick refresh. Others need more attention after sports, everyday wear, or a muddy day outside. And sometimes, you just need to dry a pair after getting caught in the rain.
With 4 dedicated modes, you can choose exactly the care your shoes need. Pick the right one for your pair, and let ClearX handle the work.
## 📱 | Brolan App
Choose a mode and start a cycle directly on ClearX, or control it from your smartphone.
Connect ClearX to the Brolan App via Bluetooth to pick the right cycle, start cleaning, and follow its progress in real time.
Have a shoe collection? The app's virtual Shoe Wall lets you add photos of your favorite pairs, organize your collection, and share it with family and friends.
## 👟 | Compatible Shoes
Your favorite sneakers, running shoes, gym shoes, and even your kids' everyday pairs. ClearX can take care of them all.
It's designed for water-washable materials like mesh, knit, canvas, and synthetic leather. Just check the care label to make sure your shoes are suitable for washing.
From kids' sizes to men's US 12, ClearX handles one pair at a time.
*ClearX is designed for all water-washable footwear. For delicate materials like suede or specialty finishes, please check the manufacturer's care label before use.
Note: Length size means the shoe’s internal length.
## 🏆 | Pro-Level Care
Getting your shoes professionally cleaned means making an appointment, dropping them off, and waiting to get them back. And every visit comes with another cleaning bill.
ClearX brings that convenience home. You can take care of your favorite pairs whenever they need cleaning, on your own schedule.
If your sneakers get dirty over the weekend or you want a fresh pair ready for the next day, you can take care of them at home instead of planning another trip to the cleaning shop.
## 🧽 | Self-Cleaning
After the robotic wiping stage, a built-in self-cleaning system rinses key internal parts to remove dirt left behind during washing.
It also cleans the ultra-soft velvet sleeves, so you don't have to take them out and wash them by hand after every cycle.
## ➕ | Even More Features
## 📊 | How We Compare
## 👥 | The Team
We’re a team of engineers, designers and shoe lovers who believe taking care of your favorite shoes should be a lot easier.
ClearX started with a simple frustration. Our founder, Siro, has been collecting sneakers for years, building a collection of over 200 pairs and even a shoe wall at home to show them off. But keeping all those shoes clean? That was another story. After trying different cleaning methods, nothing felt quite right for shoes that meant so much to him.
He knew other shoe lovers must feel the same way. So, with backgrounds from Nanyang Technological University, Harbin Institute of Technology and Tsinghua University, we set out to develop a better way to care for shoes.
The result is ClearX, which has since earned a Red Dot Design Award and been showcased at CES 2026. Meet us also at the upcoming CES 2027 in Las Vegas, USA.

faq.q: Can I clean any type of shoe with ClearX?
faq.a: ClearX is designed for water-washable shoes, including sneakers, running shoes, gym shoes, canvas, mesh, knit, synthetic leather, and kids' shoes. Materials like suede, nubuck, patent leather, wool felt, and heavily decorated shoes aren't suitable for water washing. High heels, tall boots, certain high-tops, and slippers may not fit the supports. Always check your shoes' care label before washing.

faq.q: Do I need to use the cleaning solution?
faq.a: Not for every wash. ClearX uses micro-nano bubble technology to clean shoes with water alone. For tougher stains or heavily soiled shoes, you can add the dedicated ClearX cleaning solution for extra cleaning power.

faq.q: How long does the cleaning solution last?
faq.a: A cleaning solution cartridge is expected to last approximately 1–3 months, depending on how often you use ClearX and how much solution you need. The final formulation and cartridge capacity are still being finalized.

faq.q: Can I clean more than one pair per cycle?
faq.a: ClearX cleans one pair per cycle, and that’s by design. You don’t have to wait for dirty shoes to pile up before running a wash. Clean a pair as soon as it needs it, and it’s ready to wear again in about 90 minutes. Each shoe sits securely on its own rotating support for controlled cleaning, drying, and sanitization.

faq.q: How loud is ClearX during operation?
faq.a: ClearX has a specified operating noise level of 56 dB or less during cleaning and drying. It's designed to run quietly enough for everyday home use.

faq.q: Do I need to remove the laces before cleaning?
faq.a: You can leave your shoelaces on. Just place your shoes securely on the supports and choose your cleaning mode.

faq.q: How does ClearX know the size and shape of my shoe?
faq.a: Before cleaning, ClearX automatically measures your shoes' length and matches them to the appropriate cleaning program. It then adjusts the robotic arm's movements to suit the shoes. The 360° rotating supports help expose different areas for thorough cleaning.

faq.q: Is the 50°C drying temperature safe for my shoes?
faq.a: ClearX keeps its drying temperature below 50°C (122°F) to reduce excessive heat exposure. Its dual-channel airflow dries shoes from the inside and outside, including hard-to-dry areas like the toe box and heel. The controlled temperature helps protect shoe materials, adhesives, and shape.ClearX is intended for water-washable shoes, so always follow the footwear manufacturer's care instructions.

faq.q: Does ClearX clean itself after each use?
faq.a: Yes. ClearX has a built-in automatic self-cleaning system. After the robotic wiping stage, it rinses key internal components and the ultra-soft velvet sleeves to remove dirt left behind during cleaning. The filter may still need occasional manual cleaning, and the velvet sleeves are replaceable consumables.

faq.q: Are shipping fees, taxes, and customs duties included in my pledge?
faq.a:
Import taxes, customs duties, and last-mile delivery fees are not included in your Kickstarter pledge price and must be paid separately by the backer.
Last-mile delivery is the final stage of shipping, from a local warehouse or distribution center in your destination country to your delivery address.
Any applicable import taxes, customs duties, and last-mile delivery fees are the backer's responsibility. Please keep these additional costs in mind when placing your pledge.

faq.q: What does it mean to back a project (pledge) on Kickstarter?
faq.a:
When you back a project, you’re pre-ordering the product. That means you'll get it once it's produced. Besides getting the product itself, you're also joining a community. Follow along the production process, take part in important surveys and give the ClearX team valuable feedback.
Backing is a way to support innovation and get rewarded for being early.

In order to pledge, click that green button that says “Back this project”. You'll get to select your shipping country and choose your desired pledge level and reward. You will pay for the shipping in the post-campaign survey, and you'll choose your preferred color in the post-campaign survey.

faq.q: What payment methods can I use?
faq.a: You can use any debit or credit card associated with Visa, Mastercard, or American Express, as well as Discover and JCB cards. Kickstarter does not accept payments with PayPal.

faq.q: Can I add add-ons or change my pledge after it’s been made?
faq.a: No worries! Go to “manage your pledge”, and you should be able to fix your order or add an add-on.
